text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: increased 5xx and 429s across embeddings/generation in us-west-2 since ~1965432000. Impact: degraded latency and customer errors. Automation: metrics+alerts triggered.

maria_oncall: I'm on it. first pass: can we narrow to model / route? logs show spike on /v1/embeddings and /v1/generate for model rdx-emb-large and rdx-gen-xl.

ali_sre: Confirmed. Top offenders are a handful of heavy tenants doing long prompt chains + streaming. Looks like bursty traffic from 3 customers + a misbehaving retry loop.

kate_cs: I'm seeing customer reports from AcmeCorp and BetaApps hitting 5xx. Acme is on Dedicated but Beta is hosted. Both urgent.

maria_oncall: Proposed live mitigations (landing):
- edge: apply soft global throttle for embeddings route (limit 25req/s global, burst 200)
- per-tenant: apply stricter per-token token-bucket for non-paid customers (50req/min)
- config: temporarily disable streaming for embeddings to reduce open connections for model rdx-emb-large
- quota: short-term quota uplift for AcmeCorp manually (they're paying SLA).

john_sdk: For client guidance we should push a small SDK patch + advisory:
- increase default maxRetries -> 6
- backoff: base 300ms, max 10s, full jitter
- require/encourage Idempotency-Key header on POSTs (generations, embeddings where applicable)
- respect Retry-After header and map 429 -> exponential backoff + jitter, 503 -> linear slow-down then backoff
- reduce default parallelism in streaming clients to 2 concurrent streams per token by default (configurable)

maria_oncall: Ali, can we enact edge throttle + disable streaming quickly?

ali_sre: I'll push edge rule now. Will also add a leaky-bucket per-customer shaping rule for hosted tier. Pushing as hotfix on edge-control-plane.

deploy-bot: deploy started: edge-throttle-rule v2026.3.1 -> edge-control-plane (canary us-west-2)

dev_sam: If we disable streaming for embeddings, we should ensure payloads still return synchronously with chunked responses off. Will toggle router flag `allow_streaming_embeddings=false` in canary first.

maria_oncall: Kate — can you notify Acme/Beta via CS and ask them to apply SDK patch or at least enable client-side retries? Also let them know about temporary streaming toggle.

kate_cs: on it. pinged Acme engineering + Beta product. Mentioned expected window ~30-45 mins.

john_sdk: Draft SDK advisory (short):
```
If you are seeing 429/5xx on generation/embedding endpoints:
- Upgrade SDK to 1.8.3+ (patch in canary) which enables improved retry/backoff, sets Idempotency-Key header automatically for POSTs when provided, and lowers default concurrency.
- Recommended config: maxRetries=6, baseBackoffMs=300, maxBackoffMs=10000, jitter=full
- Use Idempotency-Key for any non-idempotent request bodies to avoid duplicates.
- Implement client-side latency-based backpressure: if p95 > 2s, reduce concurrency by 50%.
```

john_sdk: I'll push 1.8.3 canary in 5.

ali_sre: Edge rule active on canary – seeing 40% drop in error rate on canary hosts. Rolling to 50% of us-west-2 now.

maria_oncall: Good. We'll hold other mitigations for 10m and re-evaluate. Ali, is there a way to detect retry storms from headers to pinpoint misbehaving SDKs?

ali_sre: We can look for patterns: repeated identical request bodies within short windows + missing Idempotency-Key. I'll add a short detection query in observability: group by client_ip + model + payload_hash.

dev_sam: Quick note for SDK team: add guidance to log when a retry occurs and expose a `retry_count` metric so we can find customer-side loops.

kate_cs: Beta says they already have a custom retry loop that retries immediately on 5xx. Asking them to add exponential backoff.

tom_pm: Are we planning to do a temporary feature disable beyond streaming? Eg. disable embeddings for certain model variant?

maria_oncall: Only if edge throttles + client patches don't stabilize within 30m. Avoid feature toggles that break contract for paying customers. We'll keep targeted per-tenant limits first.

ali_sre: Rolling edge to 100% in us-west-2 now. Error rate dropped ~68% overall; latency p95 improved. Still seeing concentrated retries from a handful of IPs.

incident-bot: Incident annotation: mitigation=edge-throttle+disable_streaming_embeddings_canary; severity lowered to p2.

john_sdk: Released SDK canary 1.8.3-canary. Changelog includes default retries/backoff and Idempotency-Key support. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/sdk/pull/4321

maria_oncall: John, timeline for stable release and a short advisory (1 paragraph) so CS can send to customers?

john_sdk: If canary is good for 30m I'll cut stable in 1h. Advisory draft: "We've applied temporary edge throttling and reduced streaming for embeddings to stabilize traffic. Please upgrade SDK to 1.8.3 which adds improved retry/backoff and idempotency support; ensure you send Idempotency-Key for non-idempotent requests and implement exponential backoff with jitter."

kate_cs: Sending advisory now with troubleshooting steps and SDK link.

ali_sre: Final check — I'll keep the per-tenant shaping for hosted tier for 2 hours, then relax. Will notify when it's lifted.

maria_oncall: On-call handoff: I'm staying on until the next status update in 40m. If anything regresses escalate to oncall-2.

dev_sam: Logging note: add temporary tag `mitigation=edge-shaper-1965432100` to metrics so we can filter impact in postmortem.

maria_oncall: Sounds good. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident resolved at 1965432445 — edge throttling + SDK adoption stabilized traffic. Follow-up: postmortem and client advisory to be drafted by ali_sre + john_sdk + kate_cs.
